neighbours.label: a modal or 'have' right after the pronoun ' I' (I should think, I must hold, I might be, I must have, I will have to, I felt like), as opposed to the same modals with other subjects
fire: We need the facts. I should think you agree.
Hold on, my friend, for I must speak now.
The band starts up and the room spins. I might be in love.
I must have seen it a hundred times on the way.
I will have to ask my sister about the date.
She smiled at me and I felt like running away.
I could have told you that last year.
Sadly I would have to say no.
quiet: We need the facts. He has the report at home.
Hold on, my friend, for he must speak now.
The band starts up and the room spins. They are good.
She must have seen it a hundred times on the way.
They will have to ask my sister about the date.
She smiled at me and he felt like running away.
You could have told me that last year.
Sadly we would have to say no.

notes: Arabic 'أكون' is on the card and not tested here.
